title: give_action_opportunity
description: The next action opportunities given in an action window go to a player, whoever would get them otherwise: at the end of the action being resolved, or when the next action window opens (Child of the Plains: the first action opportunity of the conflict; Hawk Tattoo: another action; Current of the Beryt: two actions; Austere Exemplar: three actions). The actions add up for the same player, and replace those given to another player; a player who passes in an action window loses the actions left.

target_player_id.description: Player who gets the next action opportunities.

actions.description: Number of action opportunities the player gets in a row.
